name: io.github.haxtheweb/haxcms-mcp
title: HAXcms
description: Build and edit self-hosted HAXcms sites: outlines, pages, blocks, files, themes, imports, exports.

environmentVariables.name: HAXCMS_MCP_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Root URL of the running HAXcms instance, for example http://localhost:3000

environmentVariables.name: HAXCMS_MCP_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: HAXcms user to sign in as. Leave unset to have the agent call the login tool

environmentVariables.name: HAXCMS_MCP_DEFAULT_SITE
environmentVariables.description: Site used by site-scoped tools when no site argument is passed

environmentVariables.name: HAXCMS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to reject every tool that changes anything
